scope: existing execution registry, prepared manifests, exact-response scan of local JSON materials, and named literature exposure mappings

input_deduplication.context_value: adapted context_passages list, retaining order and all original characters
input_deduplication.request_value: object with only context_passages and generated_answer
input_deduplication.candidate_internal_deduplication_rule: Before sampling exclude test source groups having exactly six good responses but duplicate full requests; among remaining non-exposed exactly-six-good groups with identical adapted-context hashes, retain lexicographically first source_id and exclude the rest. Final sampler verifies 30 unique context hashes and 180 unique full request hashes before model calls.

mapping_downloads.handling: Only four previously observed UUID records matched; other downloaded message/span rows were not shown to the implementation agent or used for selection. No native labels inspected.

supplemental_scan.scope_limit: Exact full-response strings in structured artifacts; not a proof of no unrecorded external or human exposure. Native gold files and source-code snapshots excluded.

contract_size_eligibility: Not applied here; final frozen sampler must apply unchanged input contract mechanically before selection.
untouched_qualification: Disjoint from all recorded project exposures including resolved named literature examples. Cannot certify unknown human/model-training exposure.
runtime_boundary: All IDs/mappings are evaluation bookkeeping only; never supply to inference or choose prompts/configuration from them.
